<slate title="Set up Stripe webhook" state={{ endpointUrl: "", signingSecret: "" }}>
  <column id="root">
    <section id="step-1" title="1. Create the endpoint">
      <text id="step-1-help" muted small>In Stripe, add a webhook endpoint for your app, choose the events it should receive, then copy its endpoint URL.</text>
      <input
        id="endpoint-url"
        label="Endpoint URL"
        value={state.endpointUrl}
        placeholder="https://example.com/api/stripe/webhook"
        mono
      />
    </section>
    <section id="step-2" title="2. Copy the signing secret">
      <text id="step-2-help" muted small>Reveal the endpoint's signing secret in Stripe and paste the full value beginning with whsec_.</text>
      <input
        id="signing-secret"
        label="Webhook signing secret"
        value={state.signingSecret}
        placeholder="whsec_…"
        mono
      />
    </section>
    <section id="step-3" title="3. Send both for configuration">
      <text id="step-3-help" muted small>Press once and I’ll use both values to write the webhook configuration.</text>
      <button
        id="configure"
        primary
        label="Write the Stripe webhook config"
        held="Sending webhook settings…"
        onPress={send("Write the Stripe webhook configuration using the endpoint URL and signing secret from the slate.", { with: [state.endpointUrl, state.signingSecret] })}
      />
    </section>
  </column>
</slate>
